senses.gloss:
a. 
__1 Asleep, sleeping. 
__2 Lost, destroyed. 
-झः 
__1 Beating time. 
__2 Jingling, clanking or any similar sound. 
__3 Wind accompanied by rain. 
__4 N. of Bṛhaspati. 
__5 A thing lost or mislaid. 
__6 A hurricane. 
__7 Number nine. 
-झा The descent of a cascade, waterfall; cf. झो हस्तो, झा योनिः and झं मैथुनमिति स्मृतम् [[Enm.]]; cf. also झः पुमान् श्रमणे नष्टे प्रतापे हंसचोरयोः [[Nm.]]
